item: OSM diagnostics-bundle member: position, cursor, gaps and measured cost of the daily change files (v0.6.0 B1, S06-01 S5)
summary: A producer for one diagnostics-bundle member (the slot contract: max_bytes in, dict out, never raises, newest kept, what was cut named). For each cut country that has had an update: where its objects stand (the extract position, then the last change file applied), the number of change files recorded, the substrate feed cursor, the gaps (retention = re-baseline, budget = hand re-cut; newest 10 shown, total always stated), re-baselines and hand re-cuts counted, and the cost measured where the work happened (bytes fetched, seconds to fetch and apply; null with a reason when no run exists, never 0), plus the last 7 runs. Countries with no updates are listed apart. Over budget it drops the oldest run of the heaviest country, then gaps, then the least recently updated country, and says so (countries_not_shown). Counts, sizes, labels and fixed words only: no object, tag, path, URL or exception text (an error is its class and a fixed reason). A lane cut before a table existed keeps its positions and says which table is missing; a figure no run measured is null with its reason. Opus read folded: 3 must-fix, 5 should-fix and the test gaps. Measured through the real member on the build container (Linux x86-64): 6 countries with 99 files and 10 gaps each = 24,398 B whole, 19,953 B at the 20,000 B default (26 oldest runs cut and counted), against a provisional 20,000 B. NOT wired in: the slot row in src/api/diagnostics_slots.py and the TOTAL_BUDGET_BYTES edit (sum was 595,720 of 600,000) belong to the diagnostics lane (R417).
